status.description: Classify what happened during this run. Use input_required when human input is needed, blocked when an external change is required, failed when the work failed, partial when required work remains, and success when you completed a requested action, change, answer, commit, review, or deliverable. Use no_action_needed only for a successful observational or recurring check where no new condition required action and no requested action or deliverable was completed. no_action_needed is a quiet outcome that suppresses operator unread and push notifications; never use it merely because completed work leaves no next steps.

summary.description: Concise operator-facing Markdown summary of this run. State the outcome, important changes or findings, blockers, and concrete next steps. Keep it focused enough for the Remote UI Summary page: usually 1-3 short paragraphs or bullets. After summarized, do a secondary check to not miss important details.

attachments.description: Durable artifacts and links produced or used by this run. When the run reviews or changes a pull request, include its canonical https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/pull/{number} URL as a link attachment and summarize the review outcome in summary.
